criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Part-Whole
categories.definition: One entity is a component, member, or subdivision of the other entity.

categories.name: Location
categories.definition: One entity is located in, at, or on the other entity.

categories.name: Creator-Creation
categories.definition: One entity created, authored, designed, or developed the other entity.

categories.name: Affiliation
categories.definition: One entity is affiliated with, works for, or represents the other entity.

categories.name: Origin
categories.definition: One entity originates from, was born in, or is a native of the other entity.

categories.name: Award-Nominee-Winner
categories.definition: One entity is an award for which the other entity was nominated or won.

categories.name: Event-Participant
categories.definition: One entity participated in, competed at, or was involved in the other entity.

categories.name: Family
categories.definition: One entity is related to the other entity by blood, marriage, or lineage.

categories.name: Genre-Style-Movement
categories.definition: One entity belongs to, is associated with, or is an example of the artistic style, genre, or movement of the other entity.

categories.name: Product-Producer
categories.definition: One entity is a product, model, or item produced, manufactured, or published by the other entity.

categories.name: Geographical-Feature
categories.definition: One entity is a geographical feature contained by, adjacent to, or flowing into the other entity.

categories.name: Character-Creator
categories.definition: One entity is a fictional character appearing in or created for the work of the other entity.

categories.name: Instrument-Musician
categories.definition: One entity is a musical instrument played by the other entity.

categories.name: Adaptation-Source
categories.definition: One entity is an adaptation, translation, or derivative work based on the other entity.

categories.name: Name-Relation
categories.definition: One entity is a name, title, or linguistic variant of the other entity.

categories.name: Successor
categories.definition: One entity succeeds, replaces, or follows the other entity in a sequence or role.

categories.name: Subject
categories.definition: One entity is the subject, topic, or content of the other entity.

categories.name: Owner-Possessor
categories.definition: One entity owns, possesses, or holds the other entity.

categories.name: Employer-Employee
categories.definition: One entity employs, manages, or is the superior of the other entity.

categories.name: Alliance-Group
categories.definition: One entity is a member of or allied with the other entity within a group or coalition.
